outcome: incidence of post-operative nausea and vomiting
severity of post-operative nausea and vomiting
need for treatment of post-operative nausea and vomiting
maternal satisfaction with pain relief and side effects
cohort: This study included 124 parturients who received intrathecal morphine in spinal anaesthesia for caesarean section.
finding: There is a high incidence of pruritus following intrathecal morphine in spinal anaesthesia for caesarean section, with most women reporting moderate to severe pruritus, but the incidence of post-operative nausea and vomiting is low.
